title: Answer: self states and the chances between them are fundamental

statements.text: What is fundamental is the first-person perspective: the set of self states and the objective chance, fixed by universal induction, of passing from one to the next. An information-theoretic notion of observer comes before the physical world.

sources.quote: an information-theoretic notion of observer (“mind”) could in some sense be more fundamental than our intuitive idea of a physical world (“matter”)
